newsitem.title: USA: Tecumseh Products Q1 sales fall, net flat.
newsitem.headline: Tecumseh Products Q1 sales fall, net flat.

text.p: Tecumseh Products Co said Wednesday continued slow sales in Europe and lower domestic demand for air conditioners reduced sales volumes in the first quarter ended March 31 and held earnings nearly flat.
The company posted net income of $31.5 million, or $1.44 a share, in the period compared with $31.0, or $1.41, in the first quarter of 1996.
Sales slipped to $479.6 million from $496.2 million one year ago as weakness in the European economy held down demand for Tecumseh's compressor products.
Tecumseh also said its recent acquisition of a 50-percent stake in a compressor maker in India is a significant step in its efforts to become a leading supplier in that market.
The company makes hermetic compressors for air conditioners and refrigeration products.
Its shares were off 1-1/4 Wednesday at 54-1/4.
